definitions: To make progress or move forward.
To help develop or improve something.
To pay money to someone before the due date.
To propose an idea or theory.
To move a date or time to an earlier point.
examples: The troops advanced on the enemy position.
New technology can advance medical research.
The company advanced him some money for his travel.
He advanced a new theory about the universe.
They decided to advance the meeting to Monday.
